props.name: dot
props.description: Renders the badge as a dot instead of a pill. Requires a text label for screen readers, because the dot itself conveys nothing but color.

props.name: statusLabel
props.description: Screen-reader text for the dot variant. Required when `dot` is set.

ai.summary: A static label for status, category, or count. It is not interactive.
whenToUse: It marks a record's state, such as Active, Pending, or Failed
It labels a category or count that must stand out from body copy
It marks an item in a dense list where state has to stay scannable
whenNotToUse: It is clickable — use a Button, because a badge has no interaction
It navigates — use a Link instead
It carries a value the reader selects — use a Checkbox or Switch instead
ai.accessibility: Static text, so it exposes no role and no tab stop. Each variant sets a foreground and a background measured together, so the label clears 4.5:1 against its own fill rather than only against the page. The dot variant would otherwise convey state by color alone, which WCAG 1.4.1 forbids, so it renders the consumer-supplied `statusLabel` visually hidden instead.
knownLimitations: The `statusLabel` prop is required in the React types for the `dot` variant but only warns in plain HTML
